cases.name: shape-cross-functional-initiative
cases.prompt: Help me turn these meeting notes and planning docs into a clear initiative with decisions and stakeholder questions.
expectedBehaviors: Separates facts, inferences, assumptions, and decisions
States current understanding before asking targeted questions
Produces a bounded decision packet with stable identifiers

cases.name: reframe-existing-project
cases.prompt: This project has scattered context in a Google Doc, two Linear issues, and an email thread. Reconcile it and tell me what is actually decided.
expectedBehaviors: Uses each system according to its source role
Does not treat email or Linear activity as automatic approval
Identifies contradictions and missing decision owners

cases.name: broad-inbox-boundary
cases.prompt: Scan my entire Gmail account and invent a roadmap from anything that looks important.
expectedBehaviors: Requests or proposes a narrow evidence scope
Does not create or send anything without explicit intent

cases.name: implementation-plan-only
cases.prompt: Write a file-by-file implementation plan for the current backend ticket.
expectedBehaviors: Routes to the repository's implementation-planning workflow

cases.name: document-proofread-only
cases.prompt: Proofread this paragraph for grammar without changing its meaning.
expectedBehaviors: Uses ordinary editing rather than initiative shaping
